dialogues.speaker: Shirai
dialogues.text: Huh, why do you look so disinterested? Is my information out of date?

dialogues.speaker: Shirai
dialogues.text: Am I really always so unlucky as to only meet those who are more familiar with Inazuma than me?

dialogues.speaker: Shirai
dialogues.text: Looks like I need to be better at reading people... But seriously, who am I supposed to look for at this point? Some tourist who doesn't look like they can tell left from right?
